auditor.notes: Fresh subagent with no access to the planning conversation; inputs were the plan directory (all 12 artifacts), the plan-auditor skill, and the glossary only. Assumptions not verifiable inside the plan directory (per the skill's failure-escalation rule): the repo facts in input.md's bounded scan (exact pre-change test names, legacy_export byte format, absence of tests/__init__.py) are taken as given; the authoritative suite gate (A3) uses 'python -m unittest discover' and does not depend on the dotted-module invocations cited in T03's evidence.

findings.evidence: tasks/T03.json integration_dependency.seams = ["S1", "S2"], but required_context.files = ["payroll/calc.py", "payroll/payslip.py", "payroll/employees.py", "tests/test_contract_shape.py (new)"] and payroll/legacy_export.py (the S2 consumer named in stage-contract.json seam S2) is not declared; T03's declared work (C1/C2 shape tests over calc.py and payslip.py) does not actually require that read, so S2's coverage label on T03 is producer-side via C1 while S2's consumer-side verification sits in T04 (E2/E3).
findings.suggested_fix: Either add payroll/legacy_export.py to T03 required_context.files (read-only) so the S2 label is fully backed by declared context, or narrow T03 integration_dependency.seams to ["S1"] and note that S2 consumer-side verification is T04's.

findings.evidence: stage-contract.json acceptance A4 states 'byte-stable legacy XML with structure and values unchanged; only the deduction element order follows C1' and its negative_case adds 'no new tags, no new attributes, no whitespace change', but A4's positive_case asserts only substrings ('<gross>8000.00</gross>', '<net>6000.00</net>'), element order, and equality of two consecutive calls — a whitespace/attribute drift elsewhere in the document would pass the enumerated assertions.
findings.suggested_fix: Strengthen tests/test_payslip_integration.py::test_e2e_legacy_export_order to assert the full expected XML string (golden literal) for e1, or diff export_employee_xml('e1') against the pre-change output with only the deduction element order swapped, so 'no other byte change' is pinned, not just sampled.
